guidance: the peak (maximum, stall) torque at the OUTPUT of this part, after its own gearbox
definition: Peak (stall) torque at the part's OUTPUT, after the part's own reduction if it has one. On drivetrain geared or direct_drive it is the joint's max effort as is: never multiply it by gear_ratio. On drivetrain motor it is the bare motor's shaft torque, which a separate gearbox multiplies.

guidance: the rated (continuous, nominal) torque at the OUTPUT, after its own gearbox
definition: Continuous (rated) torque at the part's OUTPUT, after the part's own reduction if it has one. A consumer never multiplies it by gear_ratio.

guidance: the no-load (maximum) speed at the OUTPUT; skip a value the source gives at the motor before the gearbox
definition: No-load (maximum) speed at the part's OUTPUT. On drivetrain geared or direct_drive it is the joint's max velocity (robot.json max_velocity_rad_s after conversion to rad/s).

guidance: the speed at rated torque, at the OUTPUT
definition: Speed at rated torque, at the part's OUTPUT.

guidance: the reduction ratio as rotor turns per output turn (9 for 9:1 or 1:9); written as the source prints it
definition: Rotor (input) turns per output turn, as a magnitude > 0: 10 for a 10:1 reducer such as the GIM4305-10, 1 for direct drive. A reversing reducer is still positive (a direction, if one is ever needed, is a separate key). cad2robot/1 robot.json stores rotor_to_output_ratio = 1 / gear_ratio. Missing means unknown, never 1, except on drivetrain direct_drive or motor, where it is 1 by definition.

guidance: the mass of the part as sold; note a stated condition such as 'with driver'
definition: Mass of the part as sold, without optional accessories.

guidance: the largest outer diameter of a round housing, only where the source marks it as a diameter (Φ, ⌀, 'diameter')
definition: Largest diameter of a round part about its Z axis (an actuator's or gearbox's housing), as the source gives it. With axial_length it sizes the In-CAD stand-in.

guidance: the overall length along the output axis; for 'Φ98*38.5 mm' it is the second number
definition: Overall length of a round part along its Z axis, as the source gives it. With outer_diameter it sizes the In-CAD stand-in.

guidance: the lowest supply voltage of a stated range (12 in '12-48 V')
definition: Lowest supply voltage the part is rated for. A port's own voltage_min states that port; this part-level value is the fallback for a port that states none.

guidance: the highest supply voltage of a stated range (48 in '12-48 V')
definition: Highest supply voltage the part is rated for. A port's own voltage_max states that port; this part-level value is the fallback for a port that states none.
Continuous output power: electrical for a PSU, mechanical (rated torque x rated speed) for an actuator.

guidance: the backlash at the output; note it in `note` when the source states an upper bound such as ≤
the rotor's moment of inertia on the INPUT (motor) side, as the datasheet quotes it; skip an output-side inertia
definition: Moment of inertia of the motor's rotor about its own axis, on the INPUT side, as datasheets quote it. A consumer reflects it to the output: armature = gear_ratio^2 x (rotor_inertia + gearbox_input_inertia). Read as output-side it is off by gear_ratio^2 (100x on a 10:1).

guidance: the motor velocity constant in rpm per volt at the rotor (before the gearbox)
definition: Velocity constant: no-load rotor speed per volt, the volt being the line-to-line peak back-EMF (what a hobby datasheet's rpm per volt of DC supply means). Kv in rpm/V = 60 / (2 pi ke), ke the line-to-line peak back-EMF constant in V·s/rad. A source that defines it another way (per phase, RMS, or a firmware's own scaling) is converted with its definition cited, or not recorded.

guidance: the number of magnetic pole PAIRS, only where the source says pole pairs (never a pole count)
definition: Number of magnetic pole pairs of the motor.

guidance: the winding resistance between two motor leads, only where the source says phase-to-phase or line-to-line
definition: Winding resistance measured between two motor leads (line to line); for a wye winding, twice the phase resistance.

guidance: the communication buses, as registry names (can, can-fd, rs485, rs232, uart, ethercat, …)
definition: The communication buses the part speaks, as a list. A folder spec uses registry buses and protocols names; an atlas's own words map through registry.bus_terms and registry.protocol_terms into the record's buses and protocols. Ports, where a part has electrical.data ports, state their own bus and win.
